column1: Purpose: Track the 100 specific people you want to work with and manage your manual outreach and relationship-building with each one.
1. Manually find 100 specific prospects man who would be a great fit as a client.
2. Fill in their Name, Email, Phone, Website, LinkedIn, Twitter/X, Instagram and Facebook as you find it
3. Use the Additional Info columns for anything else relevant.
4. Use the Notes for any additional notes you want to add for a prospect.
5. Spend 30 to 60 minutes a day working through your list, engaging with prospects and following up on conversations.
